parole.significato: bailiff (servant of the law, usually a lay person, who acted as an officer and a public witness during oral proceedings…
parole.testo: Borrowed from South Slavic, ultimately from Old Church Slavonic приставъ (pristavŭ). Compare zászló and boroszlán for the sound change /st/ > /sl/. Compare Romanian pristav. First attested in 1200.
